frontendTextSearch.conclusion: Reproduces the Phase 6.1/6.2/6.3/6.4 finding a fifth time: Tauri embeds the built frontend bundle into cip-desktop.exe in a compressed form plain strings(1)/nm(1) cannot search - 0 matches for new text is not evidence of absence, since the known-present, unchanged control string also returns 0 matches. Correctness for this phase's frontend-only change instead rests on: a fresh Vite build producing a new asset bundle hash (index-BwhMP8lV.js, this rebuild), the installer's SHA-256 changing from the Phase 6.4 baseline, and the full 248/248 frontend test pass already recorded in pilot-evidence/6.5/build/error-banner-dismiss-context-evidence.json.
